name: OpenWeatherMap Weather
description: Weather data from OpenWeatherMap One Call API 3.0

dataSources.purpose: Current weather and 3-hourly forecasts (up to 5 days). Global coverage.
dataSources.dataSent: Coordinates (latitude, longitude), unit preference, language; interval count for forecasts
dataSources.dataReceived: Temperature, feels-like, humidity, pressure, wind, clouds, weather condition, precipitation probability, rain/snow
